description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) performance across different curriculum sampling strategies for dense retrieval, as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 2 to 10. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)", is linear and spans from 2 to 10, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", is also linear and ranges from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays five distinct lines, each representing a different sampling method: a yellow line with diamond markers for "DPR w/ gold", a green line with circle markers for "DPR w/ top-1", a purple line with triangle markers for "DPR w/ bottom-1", a blue line with square markers for "DPR w/ random", and a red line with star markers for "DPR w/ curriculum". The "DPR w/ gold" line starts at an MRR@10 of 33.0 at S=2, rises to 35.0 at S=4, and continues to increase to 35.0 at S=10. The "DPR w/ top-1" line begins at 33.0 at S=2, rises sharply to 35.5 at S=4, and continues to increase to 36.5 at S=10. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" line starts at 35.0 at S=2, dips slightly to 34.5 at S=4, and then remains relatively flat around 34.5 until S=10. The "DPR w/ random" line begins at 35.0 at S=2, remains relatively flat around 35.0 until S=10, with minor fluctuations. The "DPR w/ curriculum" line starts at 35.0 at S=2, remains relatively flat around 35.5 until S=10, with minor fluctuations.
